system.description:
Always active while you have undead under your control within 30ft.

  • Controlled undead gain +1 damage per hit and +2 HP per Necromancer level
  • Once per encounter, one creature has Disadvantage on its save against a Necromancy spell you cast

rules.value: Necrotic Aura: while you control undead within 30ft, once per encounter one creature has Disadvantage on its save against a Necromancy spell you cast.
